what: Pentair makes water equipment: pool pumps, filters and heaters, residential water softeners and filtration, and industrial pumps and valves for food and beverage plants.
customers: Pool builders and service companies, plumbing contractors, and industrial customers, through distributors.
money: the largest part and most of the profit
pool pumps, filters, heaters and automation
pumps for agriculture, wastewater and industry
moat: Pool equipment is replaced on a schedule by service professionals who fit what they know, and Pentair is one of two brands that dominate American pool equipment.
risks: New pool construction fell sharply with interest rates and has not recovered
Revenue has been flat around $4.1B for four years
opportunities: A 15.7% net margin and $647M of free cash flow, after a transformation programme that raised margins
Most pool revenue is replacement rather than new build, which is far steadier
18 times earnings with the dividend raised for about fifty years
watch: Pool segment sales and the operating margin, which the transformation programme targets.
